caption:
Nothing is forcing you to decide this quarter. That is exactly why most traders don't.

There is no deadline and nobody asking, so the decision stays open — and ninety days later you are holding the same question you are holding today: was that a bad method, or a bad stretch. Without a reason written next to each trade, there is no way to answer it, and the quarter has already spent itself.

Two traders can run the same instruments, the same hours and the same size. One ends with a record he can read. The other ends with a feeling he can only argue about.

Comment "PROFILE" and I'll open the qualification. Five per month. Trading carries a risk of loss — educational programme, not investment advice.
